description: EcoPilot 3D Flight Dynamics and Physical Limits Configuration

coordinate_system.horizontal_frame: Continuous Cartesian grid with North (-row) and East (+col)
coordinate_system.vertical_frame: Altitude z in normalized [0, 1] relative to local relief plane

modeled_effects: 3D kinematic velocity and position integration with wind vector coupling
Moist air density with virtual temperature correction (ideal gas law)
Dynamic aerodynamic pressure q = 0.5 * rho * v_rel^2
Parasitic aerodynamic drag power scaling with relative airspeed cubed
Air density thrust compensation for rotor lift in hot/humid air
Vertical gravitational work for altitude climbs
State of charge (SoC) depletion from continuous electrical power integration
Bilinear terrain elevation interpolation between discrete grid nodes
Independent safety envelope monitoring with deterministic override
simplified_effects: Point mass translational dynamics (attitude and motor RPM inner loops assumed instantaneous)
Constant lumped parasitic drag coefficient c_drag = 0.08 N/(m/s)^2
Linear thrust compensation scalar k_thrust = rho0 / rho
Piecewise-constant ambient wind per control timestep with normal micro-perturbations
Fixed ground station reference frame without Earth curvature (720m x 720m patch)
